armados_columna.prompt_gemini: COLUMN ASSEMBLY - a free-standing balloon column about 2 m tall and 0.6 m across, standing on a weighted base plate at its foot, built as a stack of 9 rings of 4 round 12-inch latex balloons each, every ring turned half a step over the one below so its balloons nest in the gaps of the ring beneath, in an ordered gradient up the column from green at the base to white at the top, through green, black and white. The column ends flush at its top ring: that last ring of balloons is the highest point of the piece and its top is left bare, with no topper balloon, cluster, star or heart above it. Keep the column the same thickness all the way up and that color layout readable from the base to the top, and make the whole column only of round latex balloons: no ribbons, streamers or fabric.
